VI.description: Sends the message Msg to the window hWnd and waits until its thread has processed it\2C at most uTimeout ms\2C through user32.dll SendMessageTimeoutW (stdcall\2C called in any thread). fuFlags 2 = SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG returns at once when the thread is hung. Unlike a posted message a sent one is handled even while LabVIEW's UI thread runs a popup menu's modal loop - RemoteVI Post Input.vi sends WM_CANCELMODE (0x1F) this way to close open LabVIEW popups (measured\3A posted it is ignored). return value is non-zero on success\2C 0 on failure or timeout\3B result is the message's own result. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.
